## Luke / Trent — Project Updates

---

**Lead Magnet Build & Deployment Workflow**
- Building a Claude framework with Clayton Young to encode HubSpot/marketing requirements upfront and eliminate late-stage rework (~10 changes last deploy)
- 🔴 **Blocker:** Getting James Peters on a huddle to establish a clean handoff — desired flow is Trent + Clayton sign off → James deploys on set date, no scramble

---

**Company OS (Claude Shared Workflows)**
- Exploring giving everyone Claude access with 2–3 power users building shared workflows via GitHub repo
- Next step: collecting thoughts and potentially presenting at department heads meeting (concept doesn't land well verbally)
- No hard blocker; cost of full rollout is an open question

---

**CSM Cross-Sell at Strength Renewals**
- Lucas Green has directed Brian's team to contact private facilities 6 months pre-renewal with 3-month check-ins; some automated
- Training underway with Tony on cross-sell/upsell
- 🔴 **Blocker:** Momentum stalled after Kylah left; Alex on paternity leave in December — coverage gap is real

---

**Cleaner Data & Cross-Sell Signals**
- HubSpot cleanup underway (prerequisite for any AI ambition); third data stream to flag cross-sell signals (e.g. Strength gold plan facility downloading OS content) is planned
- No discrete open task beyond HubSpot work in progress with Clayton

---

**USR Partnership**
- In phase two for Strength: targeting ~10 customers to run USR programming over winter for outcome data
- Not ready to bring OS into the conversation yet; relationship is progressing on its own timeline
- No current blocker

---

**Strength Member Management Survey**
- An in-app Intercom question on current member management software is worth running — likely done before but results were never reviewed
- No open task assigned yet; flagging as low-lift intel opportunity

---

**Partner & Mastermind Outreach**
- Michael Durkin (Three Rivers) gave strong feedback; next step is asking him for intros to Sports Performance CEO mastermind and Overtime Athletes
- Also: checking with Nicole Foley on whether TeamBuildr has any existing Overtime Athletes relationship
- No blocker; outreach just needs to go out

---

**Product Gaps**
- Bottom-of-funnel audit in cycle one — scoping with Teofe today; comes up in every demo/orientation
- Other flagged gaps: churn report, member booked appointments in mobile app
